$comment: The version triple that defines a corpus derivation. A snapshot id is a hash of
the document, its bytes and the last two values, so changing either retires every
snapshot id. The package version is the signal a client reads to know that
happened, which is only true if it moves with them.
tests/contract.test.ts fails when loadConfig() disagrees with this file, so a
parser or extractor bump cannot ship under an unchanged server version. That
coupling was promised once and not kept; this makes it enforced instead.
